newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU probes state aid for Portuguese grain company.
newsitem.headline: EU probes state aid for Portuguese grain company.

text.p: The European Commission said on Wednesday it had opened an inquiry into Portuguese state aid of about 154 million Ecus for the publicly owned cereals marketing company, Empresa para a Agroalimentacao e Cereais SA (EPAC).
The aid consists of a state guarantee on a loan equivalent to the total debt of the company and is intended to enable it to reschedule short term payments due to banks.
"This aid has not been notified to the Commission in accordance with Article 93(3) of the Treaty," the Commission said in a statement.
The Commission noted that the interest rate was more favourable than the company would have obtained under normal market conditions.

"Given...the distortion of competition that this aid is likely to cause, the Commission has given notice to the Portuguese Government to take all necessary measures to suspend the effect of this state guarantee," the Commission said.
It has given Lisbon one month to comment.
